title: Check if Array Is Sorted and Rotated
summary: Determine if an array was originally sorted in non-decreasing order and then rotated by some number of positions, including zero rotations.
statement: Determine if an array was originally sorted in non-decreasing order and then rotated by some number of positions, including zero rotations. Allow for duplicate values in the original array. A rotation by x positions means that element at index i in the original array corresponds to the element at index (i+x) % array.length in the rotated array.
constraints: Return whether it is a nondecreasing array rotated any number of positions, including zero.
hints: A sorted circular order has at most one strict decrease, at the rotation boundary.
Count strict decreases across every adjacent pair, including last-to-first.
Return whether that circular drop count is at most one.
With zero drops the array is sorted; with one, cutting after it yields sorted order; two drops cannot be repaired by one rotation cut.
editorial: With zero drops the array is sorted; with one, cutting after it yields sorted order; two drops cannot be repaired by one rotation cut.

tests.explanation: Only the circular edge from five to one decreases, so this is a rotation of sorted order.
There are two circular decreases, so no rotation can make the order nondecreasing.
